candidates.claim: CORP_IN line 60 is the first entry of its ACL and permits tcp/443 from 192.168.30.0/24 to 10.10.0.0/16, which includes the OT subnet 10.10.10.0/24.
candidates.remediation: Narrow the destination of CORP_IN line 60 to 10.10.20.10/32 or add a deny for OT before it.

candidates.claim: CORP_IN line 60 is the first entry of its ACL and permits tcp/443 from 192.168.30.0/24 to 10.10.0.0/16, which includes the MGMT subnet 10.10.99.0/24.
candidates.remediation: Narrow the destination of CORP_IN line 60 to 10.10.20.10/32 or add a deny for MGMT before it.

candidates.claim: CORP_IN line 60 permits CORP to reach OT on tcp/443, which is not an approved cross-zone service for CORP to OT; the approved CORP service is tcp/443 to the historian only.
candidates.remediation: Limit CORP_IN line 60 to destination 10.10.20.10/32 so that no OT-side address is reachable.

candidates.claim: CORP_IN line 60 permits CORP to reach MGMT on tcp/443, which is not an approved cross-zone service for CORP to MGMT.
candidates.remediation: Limit CORP_IN line 60 to destination 10.10.20.10/32 so that no MGMT address is reachable.

candidates.claim: CORP_IN line 60 differs from the approved baseline: the destination changed from 10.10.20.10/32 to 10.10.0.0/16 for tcp/443.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the change and restore destination 10.10.20.10/32 unless the change is approved.
